description: Normalize and compare caller-supplied funding records from any labeled venue or chain with explicit units, intervals and direction. NOT a live feed. No exchange requests or unlicensed market-data resale. Simple annualization is not APY. Costs $0.0009 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

records.description: Caller-owned records with venue, symbol, rate, unit decimal/percent, intervalHours, convention positive_longs_pay/positive_shorts_pay, timestamp UTC ISO; optional chain. NOT a live feed.

rate.description: Rate for the explicit settlement interval
